Build standard BSS sets. Gholdengo: Choice Scarf or Leftovers Nasty Plot. Items: Scarf Gholdengo, Life Orb Dragonite? Multiscale + Lum Berry. Let's assign:

- Gholdengo @ Choice Scarf: Make It Rain, Shadow Ball, Focus Blast, Trick. Timid, 32 SpA/32 Spe.
- Dragonite @ Lum Berry, Multiscale: Dragon Dance, Extreme Speed, Earthquake, Ice Spinner (or Outrage/Dragon Claw). Adamant 32 Atk/32 Spe.
- Garchomp @ Focus Sash, Rough Skin: Stealth Rock, Earthquake, Dragon Claw, Swords Dance? Or Rock Tomb. Jolly.
- Kingambit @ Black Glasses, Supreme Overlord: Kowtow Cleave, Sucker Punch, Swords Dance, Iron Head. Adamant.
- Rotom-Wash @ Leftovers: Hydro Pump, Volt Switch, Will-O-Wisp, Protect. Bold/Calm, 32 HP/32 Def.
- Annihilape @ Sitrus Berry, Defiant: Rage Fist, Drain Punch, Bulk Up, Taunt. Careful/Adamant bulk.
